headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Appoints Export Monitoring Agents for Oil and Gas
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has appointed eight pre-shipment inspection agents alongside two monitoring and evaluation agents to supervise crude oil and gas export consignments.
why: Crude oil and gas exports account for the vast majority of Nigeria's foreign exchange earnings and public revenue.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Tighter pre-shipment inspection of oil and gas exports aims to verify volumes and foreign exchange receipts.
